verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a probe showing Grafana publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. That is a developer building block, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples. No evidence shows a browsable API explorer or try-it-now examples, so the spec earns no credit toward this story.
